# Facade Code repository

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository routing and safeguards.

IDE work lives in `ide/`; follow [the IDE instructions](../ide/.github/copilot-instructions.md) and run its commands
from that directory. IDE specifications are in `docs/ide/`. The outer `extension/` and `docs/extension/` directories
are reserved for the standalone extension and its documentation.
